summary: AlembicAgent rework-2 completed. Commit a4cf3f8b23a23a92226a128fdee32b0633e6abdd fixes terminal.exec audit persistence by making ToolAuditEntry.requestId optional and omitting requestId from live terminal audit entries, so repeated identical commands no longer reuse a commandHash-derived AuditLogger persistence id. Preserved .log(entry), action/resource terminal.exec, result, duration, data.commandHash, no raw command text, and non-fatal audit failure behavior. Added regression coverage for repeated identical terminal.exec audit attempts.
